# SK0003 — The documentation comment is not well-formed XML

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

A `///` comment does not parse as XML, so it is left exactly as written.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Formatting |
| Default severity | hint |
| Scope | Syntax |
| Needs a compilation | no |
| Fix | no |
| Language version floor | — |
| Since | 0.4 |

## Why

Malformed doc comments are common in real code — an unescaped `<`, a `<br>` borrowed from HTML, a tag someone forgot to close. Skala never repairs them: a formatter that repairs documentation is a formatter that changes what the documentation says. Reporting it is the whole of the response.

## Example

Instead of:

```csharp
/// <summary>Returns x < y.</summary>
```

Write:

```csharp
/// <summary>Returns x &lt; y.</summary>
```

## When it does not fire

None known. The check is an XML parse of the comment body.
